title: Elha Nympha’s camp cites breach of contract for her withdrawal from 'Inday the musical'
summary: Singer Elha Nympha’s legal camp has released an official statement regarding her abrupt departure from the production of 'Inday: The Musical' a day before the show’s opening night.
